note: OpenAPI schema fidelity fixes: one shared helper reopens every object embedded next to keys serde never shows it (closed objects, map variants and min/maxProperties bounds, through $ref branches, newtype / transparent wrappers, recursive generic instances and nested enums), so a flattened untagged enum with a deny_unknown_fields or map variant, a flattened wrapper around an externally tagged enum, and an internally tagged newtype payload that is a closed enum, a wrapper or a closed recursive generic instance no longer reject the outer keys or the tag; a field alias equal to the wire name, or repeated, is that one name instead of a group nothing satisfies; Result<T, E> branches allow exactly one key; super::Alias never expands to the handler module's own alias.
